newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico creates electricity technology commission.
newsitem.headline: Mexico creates electricity technology commission.

text.p: Mexico's Energy Minister Jesus Reyes Heroles has officially created a new commission to advise the government in long-term electricity technology projects, the ministry said in a statement Friday.

"The new body will have as among its principal tasks, to define and evaluate new technology in research, transmission, assimilation and adaptation that will impact the electricity sector in the medium and long term," the statement said.
The new commission was also designed to help the nation decide among future technologies and energy sources, according to the ministry.
Members include private sector company officials, electric engineers and engineering professors.
